fields.title: 📖 Abū Zurʿah and Abū Ḥātim: The Jahmiyyah are Kuffār
fields.body:
🖋️ **Abū Zurʿah ar-Rāzī and Abū Ḥātim ar-Rāzī** said in meaning:

***“The Jahmiyyah are Kuffār.”***

They explained that the **Qurʾān is the Word of Allah** and is **not created**. Whoever claims that the Qurʾān is created commits Kufr; and whoever understands this Kufr and still doubts it is judged severely.

🌙 **Conclusion:** This statement is a clear example of **Takfīr bil-ʿUmūm** concerning a doctrine and the group that follows it. At the same time the boundary remains important: the ignorant person, or one who stops because of unclarity, is taught; the judgment upon an individual remains bound to conditions and impediments.

immutable.source: 📝 al-Lālakāʾī, Šarḥ Uṣūl Iʿtiqād Ahl as-Sunnah wa-l-Jamāʿah, Abschnitt Iʿtiqād Abī Zurʿah wa Abī Ḥātim, in der Shamela/Dār-Ṭaybah-Ausgabe: Teil 1, S. 198–200; dort: 'wa anna al-Jahmiyyah kuffār' und die Regel zum Qurʾān.
immutable.scholar: Abū Zurʿah ar-Rāzī und Abū Ḥātim ar-Rāzī
